description: This Java class 'LogView' extends TextView and implements LogNode to display log data received through the LogNode interface. It formats log messages, converts log levels to readable strings, and appends log entries to the UI, supporting chaining with the mNext LogNode.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data received via the LogNode interface, formatting and displaying log messages in the UI.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message, including priority, tag, message, and optional exception, updating the UI thread.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView display.
